info.title: MinerU API
info.description:
Parse documents into structured Middle JSON via self-hosted or remote capacity.

Submit a JSON files array to `/v1/tasks`, upload missing files to their one-hour URLs,
then poll the task and download each completed file's `result_url`. Each file runs
as soon as it is ready; other files may still be waiting for upload. File
entries can instead provide a source `url`, with optional `bytes`; workers download
these inputs in the background. Choose one or more of default/docx/html/latex in
`output_formats`. Task status contains metadata only, never inline result bytes.
Health and usage
endpoints report server readiness and quota state. Tiers (`flash`, `basic`,
`standard`, `advanced`) select the quality/speed trade-off; the set advertised
by `/v1/tiers` is what this server can actually serve.

get.description: Retrieve a single model by ID.
发布 PDF/图片可选档位；原生文档的固定 Flash 能力不由该列表控制。
直接流式发送已保存的产物，下载期间持有文件租约。

post.description: 先验证 JSON 再建立稳定任务 ID，HTTP 结束后逐文件工作独立继续。

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: PDF/image tier only. Omitted or null selects the first supported tier in the order standard, basic, flash, advanced; advanced is automatic only when it is the sole available tier. Explicit unsupported tiers are rejected. All servers support native document formats with flash, independently of /v1/tiers and ignoring any valid tier value.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: Logical basename, not a path. No '/', backslash, ':', Unicode Cc control characters, or names '.' / '..'. Hidden names and spaces are allowed; accepted names are preserved without trimming or URL decoding.

page_range.title: Page Range
page_range.description: PDF page selection: 1-based inclusive ranges, e.g. '1-5,8,r3-r1'; 'r1' is the last page and 'all' selects every page. Blank means unspecified. Selections are sorted and deduplicated; out-of-bounds pages are omitted. Reversed ranges, '~' and negative page numbers are invalid.

items.title: TaskFileInput
items.description: 仅声明输入，文件标识由服务端分配，不接受任何客户端 ID。

schema.title: CreateTaskRequest
schema.description: 严格 JSON 创建请求，清单是数组而不是编码后的字符串。

get.description: 读取逐文件状态与结果地址，上传链接截止时间保持不变。

put.description: 每条上传链接只接收一个文件，该文件就绪后立即提交执行。

post.description: 统一取消等待上传与正在执行的任务，不重建后台作业。

CancelTaskResponse.title: CancelTaskResponse
CancelTaskResponse.description: 取消回执只描述本次取消后的确定终态，不携带上传或查询扩展字段。

CanceledTaskFile.title: CanceledTaskFile
CanceledTaskFile.description: 取消回执保留每个文件的终态、可下载产物和失败原因。

CreateTaskResponse.title: CreateTaskResponse
CreateTaskResponse.description: 创建回执独立于查询详情，后续详情扩展不会进入创建响应。

CreatedTaskFile.title: CreatedTaskFile
CreatedTaskFile.description: 创建回执只提供输入映射、当前状态和可执行的上传动作。

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description: 公共错误只使用稳定错误码和说明，可选参数路径用于精确定位输入。

FileObjectModel.title: FileObjectModel
FileObjectModel.description: A file resource (source or parse output).

TaskDetailResponse.title: TaskDetailResponse
TaskDetailResponse.description: 任务状态只携带元数据；每个成功文件提供自己的下载链接。

TaskFileDetail.title: TaskFileDetail
TaskFileDetail.description: 用统一状态描述文件准备和解析，上传对象仅表示客户端当前可执行的动作。

TaskUploadLink.title: TaskUploadLink
TaskUploadLink.description: 描述一个文件的上传目标，客户端原样使用服务端给出的地址和请求头。

UploadFileResponse.title: UploadFileResponse
UploadFileResponse.description: 确认一次文件上传，仅返回对应文件的身份和当前状态。
